name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A person or account in a small space: a photo, or initials on the hue their name always gets; presence dot; circle for people, square for companies.
whenToUse: People and accounts in lists, comments, menus and headers.
A presence mark next to a name (PresenceDot) where the status needs a glance, not a sentence.
notFor: Brand logos in lists (an image in item).

anatomy: face: initials on the name's hue, or a photo
presence mark, cut out of the face (bottom inline-end)

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style address the visual root; typed classNames addresses documented closed internal parts. Public refs retain the actual native root.

notes: Nesting input (O1 §14.1, as Button): reads --pui-nest-radius / --pui-nest-inset from a parent and rounds to max(0, radius − inset); otherwise its own corner. --pui-avatar-radius (square faces; circles stay circles) overrides both.
